markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (42%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Blur flags input reliability [F6], while InSitu (42%) ties Benign (42%) and cannot exclude Invasive (11%) [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 42%, Benign 42%, Invasive 11%, Normal 4% (ECE 5%, n=132) | Virtual tie; 11% invasive risk |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu, Invasive at 90% target (90% test coverage, n=132) | Cannot separate three classes |
| Reliability / OOD | 19% reliability, 100% OOD, flagged (error AUROC 70%, n=1716) | Suspect input from blur |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | False (different top class) | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 2/5 (40%) InSitu; nearest is Benign at 72% [F5] | Mixed reference neighbor labels |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 7, 10) · context · Above-typical score (+1.22) [F2]; descriptive only (8/20 AI check) · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 3) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.04) pushes away from invasive [F3] (19/20 AI check) · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 0) · ↑ invasive · Scarce lobules (+0.08) [F4], but unreliable concept (0/20 AI check) · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Low slide-wide fraction pushes slightly toward invasive (20/20 AI check) · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; deleting top 3 risk regions drops P(invasive) by 0.0114 over random (95% CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); leans on unreliable normal lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20), and mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 blur on this simulated frozen section masks invasive or benign morphology; check drafted recut and deeper levels.
- Lesion is actually Benign (42%; nearest case 72% similar) or Invasive (11%), while cell segmentation is disabled.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 5, 6, 1**: Inspect highest-risk regions (76%, 33%, 13% invasive risk) for ductal atypia versus stromal invasion.
2. **Regions 2, 1, 3, 0**: Evaluate superior (94%) and medial (88%) margins; margin call is deferred to permanent sections [F7].
3. **Regions 7, 10, 11**: Check dense lymphocytic infiltrate (regions 7, 10) and benign stroma (region 11) against blur artifact.
